notes.title: List of Changes for Sands of Glory Update
notes.content:
Sands of Glory Update is now live!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/8ac57be21d4b9a9b4a0d6d7b2782c0841c1c6be6.png[/img]
Lords and Ladies of the Monastery,

It’s so hard to believe that nearly six months have passed since Grimlord's launch. Through your endless support and our studios' tireless effort, we're thrilled to announce that we've reached a major milestone on our development roadmap: the Arena Mode and Arena Questline Free Expansion is now officially live!

This brand new expansion introduces a series of arena-based challenges carefully woven into each chapter's theme. We’ve added new enemies, thrilling boss fights, and rewards that expand the weapon upgrade system, making your arsenal deadlier than ever. Alongside that, you’ll find brand-new weapon components and armor sets to discover.

The Arena Questline is designed for all kinds of players. For newcomers, it's a powerful tool to grow stronger. For New Game Plus veterans, it offers a fresh game mode and more than 30 new challenges. And if you enjoy testing your builds or recording exciting battles to share, the arena is now your perfect proving ground to create your own enemy combinations and dive into the killing spree!

Back during Early Access, many of you told us you wanted sandbox-style features, and that's what inspired us to develop the Arena Mode in the first place. We made a promise officially to bring this to life. While Grimlord wasn't initially designed with a sandbox arena at its core, we quickly realized how much it could enrich the game's longevity and enjoyment.

At first, we thought this would be a quick addition, maybe a few weeks of work. But reality proved otherwise. Integrating the arena with the questline added complexity we didn’t foresee, and it took more time and effort than expected. Since launch, we've redesigned the system from the ground up and expanded it from one arena map to three. Most importantly, all of this new content is 100% FREE, NO EXTRA PAYMENT REQUIRED. We want to offer more bangs for your bucks to anyone who purchased Grimlord!

We've also listened closely to community feedback and continued improving earlier content. As a small team releasing our first game, we've faced many challenges. VR is still a gaming medium in its youth, and developing Grimlord has at times pushed us beyond our limits. But we've met those challenges with passion and dedication.

In this update, we've rebuilt the weapon physics system. Slash and pierce mechanics have been completely rewritten, offering more depth and realism. Spiked polearms can now stab from multiple directions. Spikes on shields are no longer just decorative. And with enough force, your weapon may even be embedded in an enemy's body. We wanted combat to feel more tactile, authentic, and uniquely fun.

These improvements will also benefit the upcoming MOD support, which is just around the corner. Stay tuned to our community channels for updates!

Lastly, we want to address the broader state of VR. Over the past few months, skepticism about the VR industry has been growing. Indeed, not every game is performing well, but we remain deeply confident in the future of VR gaming. We're committed to continuously optimizing Grimlord and delivering new content. Your support fuels our progress. This is a journey for the ages, and we're in it for the long haul.

To our incredible community: thank you. Especially to those who joined our tests and shared your feedback, your support and dedication helped shape Grimlord into what it is today.

We want to say a very special thank you to: Aerith, Banshee, Blaze, Chickensink, Cim, Dare, Deepestlore, DelayZe, Dino, Fox, Hiei, Ithious, Jagger, Jarv, JessikaNova, KUPOkinz, Lethalxxdose, MiaLunaria, MORK, Morkle, MythicAssassin8, NavKiro, NovaFae, OFF_TRK, Pakwei, Shenanigans303, Silverfire, Skadi, Suha04, Tarquinn2049, The CLBJ, The French Pineapple, unknownasphalt, vrBuddy, yee, ZURRR_111 for your help in testing and support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/b27a5ee0a72a9b4e7f35c8bae921e70881fa6b0f.png[/img]
New Additions
• New Maps – Added four new levels, including the 3 Arenas and the Arena Hub.
• New NPC – A quartermaster is now available early in the game. Found at the Arena Hub and accessible anytime.
• Arena Questline – A dedicated Arena questline featuring 18 unique challenges.
• Custom Battle Mode – Create your own battles in the Arena for personalized combat scenarios.
• Training Questline – Visit the Faithless to learn advanced melee techniques in a new storyline.
• Weapon Upgrade System – Use materials earned through Arena challenges to upgrade and enhance weapons.
• New Enemy Types – Bandits, Gladiators, Goblin Priests, Goblin Berserkers, Wolves
• Arena Boss Battles – Each Arena level now features its own boss fight.
• New Armor Set – The Gladiator Armor is now available.
• New action - You can kick enemies, or use headbutts.

Improvements
• Opening Cinematic – Replaced all AI-generated elements. The intro cutscene is now fully handcrafted.
• Weapon Physics Overhaul – Weapons can now pierce from multiple angles. Heavy slashes may embed into enemy bodies.
• Environmental Detail – Added more vegetation and visual variety to make environments feel more dynamic.
• Talent Reset Button – Now includes a hold-to-reset progress bar to prevent accidental resets.
• Lighting Improvements – Enhanced lighting setups in several key areas.

Balance Adjustments
• Boss Defense – Reduced defense for some bosses when hit in weak spots or during specific vulnerable states.

Weapon Balancing
• Maidenblood Blade – Piercing: 52 → 36 | Slashing: 40 → 32 | Stability: 30 → 15
• Monarch – Slashing: 45 → 48
• Royal Sword – Slashing: 40 → 35
• Broadsword – Piercing: 37 → 29
• Faithkeeper Sword Handle – Passive changed from Deeper Cuts (+12% slashing damage two-handed) → Enforce (+12% physical skill damage)
• Nomadic Warrior Armor – Movement Speed: 540 → 500

Meta Exclusive
• Blood Effects – Blood now displays properly during combat.
• Hit Detection – Increased collision thickness on certain weapons to reduce clipping caused by framerate inconsistencies.

Steam Exclusive
• DX12 Texture Fix – Resolved a bug where some textures appeared blurry under DirectX 12.

Thank you all so very much for the continued support and we hope everyone enjoys the update!

notes.title: Grimlord v1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/a289b02f58c76fce88734ea0850f09f56ab90fd2.png[/img]

[h1]Dear Brave Adventurers,[/h1]

It has been two months since the official launch of the game, and we are actively working to address various issues highlighted by the community. We are also steadily developing new content.

In this significant update, we addressed the frequently raised issue of lost weapons. Now, when a player's character dies, all dropped weapons will be retrieved by Pech and respawned near the resurrection point. You won't need to rummage through the monastery anymore. Please note that this feature will not activate if you use the teleport feature, to avoid a situation where a bunch of weapons rain down on you every time you arrive at a teleport point. Overall, this adjustment will greatly enhance the gameplay experience. We welcome any further suggestions and encourage you to participate in the community discussions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/5e0bfa5a9eaf335925f3d21cc3fb3b442869f823.gif[/img]

Furthermore, we have increased the frequency of physics calculations. We have also addressed the issue of weapon penetration through monsters, which Meta Quest players have reported. While it's hard to eliminate this issue for now, our testing indicates that only high-speed and short attacks may be missed. We hope these improvements will enhance the experience for Meta Quest users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/3931cb54e6b74cd0f581c3265f28775039c91bd9.gif[/img]

In terms of future plans, we are intensifying our preparations for the arena mode, along with a storyline and quests that complement this mode. The arena will be an extension of the main storyline, featuring its own narrative threads that are still connected to the main plot. The rewards obtained from the arena will also help us explore the main storyline more effectively.

We remain dedicated to improving players' experiences and fostering an active and open community. If you have any insights about Grimlord, we invite you to join our community discussions.

To know more about the rest of the update, read through the patch notes below.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]v1.0.5 Update Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapon Recovery Mechanism: Weapons dropped upon a player's death near the respawn point, the navigation station.
[*] New Boss State - The Guardian: Players can now knock off the Guardian's helmet, allowing headshots that deal increased damage.
[*] UI Hint for Skipping Cutscenes: Introduced a UI prompt for players to skip cutscene animations.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Physics Enhancements: Improved the frequency of physical related to hands and weapons, reducing the failed swing physics.
[*] Collision Feedback for Enemies: Enhanced the physical collision response from certain enemies.
[*] Post-Processing Effects: Upgraded post-processing effects to improve visual quality (SteamVR).
[*] Change: The default grip point for the Dueling Sword has been adjusted.
[*] Change: Summoned enemies no longer drop Matter.
[*] Change: The Matter acquisition rate for each NG+ tier has been reduced from 50% to 20%.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chapter Two Taskline: Resolved a rare issue causing interruptions in the taskline for Chapter Two.
[*] Translation Errors: Fixed several translation errors.
[*] Weapon Lock Issue: Corrected the problem where a player’s weapon would become locked in space after the character's death.
[/list]

[h1]Dear Brave Adventurers,[/h1]

It's been a while since the game's release, and we’ve received a lot of feedback since then. We appreciate Grimlord and the entire community as a whole, and a significant part of it has been positive. 

Thank you sincerely for your support! We are committed to ongoing optimization and content updates because this is a long-term endeavor that doesn't end with the game's launch.

We are proud to have a highly active community where players engage, explore, and share valuable suggestions. We’ve also noted various issues players have encountered. Many have expressed that spell casting is difficult to use and ineffective.

In response, we've improved the tutorial for the spell casting, and buffed the mana damage. Additionally, some new players found certain early-game enemies quite challenging, so we’ve made adjustments to make sure everyone can get through the first 2 levels in an easier way.

However, this doesn’t mean defeating enemies will be easy; you will still need to be fully engaged in the combat!

Looking ahead, we are strictly following our roadmap. Soon, you can expect the introduction of arena quests and a dedicated arena mode, along with a new enhancement system. These changes will provide new players with better progression paths and offer more enjoyment for those with multiple New Game+ runs. We are also excited to soon support modkits, which are nearly ready for use.

This will bring a whole new world to the game, and we can't wait to see the creativity players will unleash!

notes.title: Grimlord Fully Releases on Steam & Meta Quest!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=fp5aAbxm95E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Brave Adventurers, the time has come![/h1]

After nearly four years of development, Grimlord in all of its full glory is finally ready for you.

Now rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5, the game features a complete story —— 4 chapters, 12 boss battles, and over 150 weapon parts for you to craft your instrument of destruction. It has evolved into a fully-fledged RPG, packed with secrets to be uncovered.

Trust us - if you love dark fantasy RPGs, playing one developed especially for VR will be something you'll cherish for the longest time.

Allow us to reintroduce some of the game’s key features so all can understand what kind of experience awaits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/36b9320d70d10d97f3ef42797e74b6cc81fea131.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d76963ac39b6c73620ffe3102e4e9c890219086a.png[/img]
[h2]Unreal Engine 5 Upgrade![/h2]

[h3][b]Improved Parry![/b][/h3]

Grimlord harnesses the power of Unreal Engine 5 and the cutting-edge Chaos Physics System to deliver combat that feels truly immersive. Every attack is dynamically calculated for realistic feedback, making each clash of blades and block of a shield feel visceral and authentic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/f6a037bef8104ddf74810c42aa6112f8bb41fa8f.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Immersive Interactions[/b][/h3]

Dive into a world brimming with life, where interactions with NPCs and creatures are enhanced by a physics-driven character system. Whether you're negotiating with a mysterious figure or grappling with a formidable monster, every encounter feels tangible and reactive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/68cc75d43477e75878c7210640292826d222af29.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Facial Expressions[/b][/h3]

For the full release, we've pushed the boundaries of immersion even further with expressive monster animations. Some of these are crafted using motion capture and facial capture technology, ensuring their movements and expressions are strikingly lifelike. From menacing glares to savage strikes, these enemies feel more real than ever before.

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Enhanced Physics Across the Board![/b][/h3]

With the powerful capabilities of UE5, we are pushing the limits of game physics. Experience the most immersive physics ever in Grimlord VR!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/8ec8738d050405c6bd980639d5ff1af3f2e9b876.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/201ce3eb0df0d8737c38919d5585647e2c009329.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/254f2201525551f409ff6e42870499ba30d7278b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d76963ac39b6c73620ffe3102e4e9c890219086a.png[/img]
[h2]Unique Skills & Spells [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/889c138c62607ca9e86657a5e6553ae68780dcf2.gif[/img]

Magic is vital in Grimlord's medieval fantasy world, offering players five distinct branches to master. From the destructive fury of Fire, Ice, and Wind, to the enigmatic powers of Shadow and the divine grace of Holy, each magical path opens up unique talents and specialized builds. Some weapons even harbor exclusive skills etched into their very essence, adding depth and strategy to your already-expanded arsenal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/29d280eac839535a8ccbc729afa1ec48d274533d.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Newest Magical Staff![/b][/h3]

Channel your inner mage by casting spells through rune-drawing mechanics, bringing dark and powerful magic to life right before your eyes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/1d677adec1bd3a0ad2c16bbda42994e0cbccefda.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Weapon Talents![/b][/h3]

Feeling bland holding a weapon on your hand? To become truly unstoppable, upgrade your character's combat potential through the robust talent system, featuring a detailed talent tree that tailors your playstyle. Try to attach talents and skills to your weapons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/8a496112086ca55eff23d5dcc90e48017ac51b4c.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Customize Your Combat Style![/b][/h3]

And as you venture deeper into the world, adapt your playstyle by swapping weapon skills on the fly, seamlessly navigating the intuitive skill-swapping interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/42c58168721bc7e243368c5912b3d765172565d8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d76963ac39b6c73620ffe3102e4e9c890219086a.png[/img]
[h2]Tons of Weapons![/h2]

[h3][b]Say Hello to the Old Pal Blacksmith![/b][/h3]

Take your gear to the next level by visiting the Blacksmith, where you can unlock weapon schematics to craft distinctive, personalized armaments. BUT, how many extra weapon parts did you notice?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d7134b9f5bdaf0b45fff895b5bd4c7dfc768a032.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Upgraded Bows?[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/fbfe479b91d8ae0bf3159e3ea318cdb92a1d04d6.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Flambert? Rapiers? What are they?[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/be240e2090434cbe34903f6d66d33fd21e3fd471.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/a407ab6b99d395f44953528c97b64555b1b9b81d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/e62af93f3cb55ee4cd6b836d48195c73133dbcde.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Monstrous Shield?[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/3ce8ba3bd5a52ebcbddf2d4013137ce33c5b84b3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d76963ac39b6c73620ffe3102e4e9c890219086a.png[/img]
[h2]Full 3 Chapters[/h2]

[h3][b]Journey Expanded![/b][/h3]

The journey through Grimlord grows darker and more treacherous as you venture deeper into its haunting world. After navigating the perilous outer perimeters of Castle Arugiet (Castle Roar) in Chapter One, the adventure takes you to the eerie and enigmatic Gloomy Estate, home to the mysterious Herbalist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/6fbd66d5321836a72673ec2bfcf725984237d95f.gif[/img]

With the sealed gates to the inner castle unlocked, players will advance to the very heart of Castle Arugiet—a stronghold brimming with the full might of the King’s Forces. Each step further into this oppressive fortress raises the stakes, testing your skill and resolve in battles against its formidable defenders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/892a3b9ac693b450ff022d6e0d301bd60a105fd5.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Bosses —— The Old Remains...[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/1ddadd23a66b73e241eef9dd16a17fdf9acf1018.gif[/img]

As you venture further, you'll encounter additional challenges and diverse tales. Some are the guardians of the ancient world, while others are here to challenge you... From their distinct designs and deadly movesets to rich backstories and epic, original soundtracks, each boss encounter feels like a monumental event. These battles demand strategy, skill, and courage to overcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/e3239787dbc465af978fcb50d6e0150199e48138.gif[/img]

Grimlord challenges you to conquer its beautifully bleak world, offering an unforgettable blend of exploration, combat, and storytelling at every turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d76963ac39b6c73620ffe3102e4e9c890219086a.png[/img]
[h2]New Companions[/h2]

In Grimlord, every step of your journey brings you face-to-face with a cast of unforgettable NPCs, each playing a vital role in both gameplay and the rich tapestry of the game’s lore.

Some will soothe your heart and help you grow stronger, like Rheala, whose presence offers comfort and the means to hone your skills for the trials ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/5c9ac6a48235607446df381a9ce56dcae9cdb627.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/80c27c8b168c54fb62b2c0b33c9c2f668107adee.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Black-Hearted Merchant, or a Generous Helper?[/b][/h3]

And some will trade rare and unique items that could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Seek out the merchant, whose wares offer opportunities to customize your arsenal and uncover hidden potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/8c106f17c7842f6719f48cdaabba0457bf06d28f.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Goblin in the House![/b][/h3]

The mysterious helper in your house! What's he up to?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/3b1ded00fa2ad411a1ea193cf6860e1c9d89c004.gif[/img]

But that’s just the beginning. Grimlord is brimming with secrets waiting to be discovered: hidden paths that reward the curious, treasure chests filled with riches, and weapon parts that allow you to further customize your gear to suit your playstyle.

In Grimlord, every encounter, every discovery, and every choice deepens your connection to its dark and immersive world, ensuring that no two adventures are ever the same.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/2e56a15c0601c3453c23d8a2cdd22c57a2baf2fa.png[/img]

[h1]What better time of the year than a Halloween full of updates? 🎃[/h1]

Last time, we talked about the dawn of a new Grimlord Era. Now, we're switching things up - tenfold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/0de03accd58f109725236fc721a49658e68a15d3.gif[/img]

An engine upgrade, a closed beta, an in-game Halloween event, Rhaela bringing her treats and tricks into Discord, and our participation for Steam Scream Fest 3 - all jam-packed into one spook-tastic major update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/587d41a6d64794a4e3a1bbf9788430eea26bd60e.gif[/img]

Let's have a look at what the time of shadows have brought upon us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/f5184827de642d7583ee7fb6b130d18a312c4caf.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Unreal Engine 5 - A Sprint to the Future[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/69147bca125ea4359ce715ffd49bd90f032c2947.gif[/img]

We're starting off with the biggest news - Grimlord is now on Unreal Engine 5.

With the move to the latest Unreal Engine 🍬, we're bringing key technological advancements to Grimlord with the aim of significantly enhancing the player experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/b65c253c2133990f3bae909ec4fe3776b99dd981.gif[/img]

Some of the massive improvements to Grimlord brought by the move to Unreal Engine 5 include, but are not limited to:

[b]A New Physics System[/b] - UE5's new Physics system offers more granular control over physics simulations, allowing for more customized and realistic effects. This enhances combat accuracy, world immersion, and realism, especially in VR.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/cd0152b54e72465214eb6f5f40881e93dbdbfe54.gif[/img]

[b]Bigger Development Breathing Room[/b] - UE5's potential for development brings us better ways to manifest our vision into reality - making it possible to expand some in-game mechanics. The best example is the Talent System, which has been updated to the latest version, allowing players to level up to 30 and have full access to the complete talent tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/2c862059e6235d21faa9331e6b55e1ca4f0ef1ce.gif[/img]

[b]A Truly Immersive World[/b] - UE5 allows for incredibly detailed environments without sacrificing performance. It's particularly beneficial for Grimlord as a VR game, where high-quality visuals are crucial for total immersion. It also offers significant performance improvements, especially for VR, where frame rate and latency are critical.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/b302dce3bc45d699371047378ecca5e76f52f832.gif[/img]

The move to Unreal Engine 5 is just the tip of the iceberg. Overall, this has allowed us to determine what to include on the renewed roadmap.

[b]We'd love to hear from you about the move to Unreal Engine 5. Let us know your thoughts, feedback, suggestions, and anything else on Discord![/b]

notes.title: Grimlord v0.4.9 Beta Preview
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Lords of the Monastery:[/h3]
We are so psyched to announce that there is a major update on the way, in which we have improved the enemy combat system. Previously, when you blocked an attack it would interrupt the enemies’ combo. 

Once you master the enemies’ starting moves, the entire combat experience becomes boring. Based on community feedback on this aspect, we have improved the combat system. When facing enemies’ continuous attacks, you need to parry at the right moment multiple times to prevent yourself from being damaged. 

Please notice that in this update we clearly differenciate parrying and blocking.

[b]Blocking -  If you only raise your weapon to block the opponent's attack, you will not be damaged, but this move will drain your poise bar faster and eventually make you drop your weapon. [/b]
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/0cfd52dcbe8a2535e3598375a3bcdfa5a7daa6aa.gif[/img]
[b]Parrying - If you actively swing your weapon against an opponent's attack, you will barely consume any of your poise. Instead, it will drain the enemies’ poise by a chunk and make them fall to the ground or stunned.[/b]
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d8c651fc05f3e34e856c8ff82c4eba888a5c136f.gif[/img]

Additionally, we've improved weapon hitboxes in this update, making parrying and blocking more accurate. The glitch that caused some parts of weapons to be unblockable in the past has also been fixed.

  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/1e6c26444d29ed53e5a1ad544258e4c4b0eedb17.gif[/img]

We have also slightly adjusted the enemy AI. While blocking combos, they may suddenly change their attack pattern, making the combat more diverse and dynamic, and of course, harder than before.

  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/81db16fd60124b59ce3d72833f756372dd6d278d.gif[/img]

We will release this update as a preview first, if you want to give it a try, you can pull it up from the game version selection page. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/067f20a9ce97846b601ad0f602fbdb7b09cc72ea.jpg[/img]

Please consider join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/SZCcHQ8xjm]discord[/url] and provide your feedback there at #049-preview-feedback forum. We are going to read and reply every single one of them :)

Cheers
Grimlord Devs

   Two weeks ago, we launched the standalone device version of Grimlord (on Quest Applab). Everything is working perfectly so far, and the standalone version will provide almost the same experience as the PC version, except for some graphics differences. We know that everyone is waiting for the second chapter. Everything is going well so far. We did some internal testing and are happy to report that several sections in the level can already be played with minimum issues. We are also preparing the AI for new enemy types and BOSS battles. Another important piece of news is that we started the production of the third chapter a few weeks ago. We will evaluate chapters 2 and 3 as a whole for the completeness of the story, maybe the two chapters will be launched at the same time and bring the story home with a memorizing climax. There is much to be considered, and we hope you, our beloved fans, will wait patiently for a little bit longer.

notes.content:

Dear fellow adventurers! 

It has been a little over a year since we revealed Grimlord on steam back in June 2022. During this year, we have made unrelenting efforts to produce new content and listen to all your feedback and opinions from the community. 

Today, Grimlord offers a smoother dark-fantasy experience, a deeper and more comprehensive system, and unique mechanics. Now we've reached a point where it's ready for all players to have a taste, so we've decided to launch Early Access.

We have polished and optimized tons of details down to the nitty gritty in the past 12 months. Current playable content contains the prologue and the first chapter of the game. Which offers the beginning of a complete story line and a peek into Grimlord’s massive lore, several challenging bosses, and an abundant of weapons and weapon parts. Crafting system, talent tree, active skills are all there for you to explore. 

We strive to bring a genuine action role-playing adventure into VR and present it as close to perfection as we possibly can. Its challenges, interactions, narratives, balances, physics-based combat, each of which requires hundreds of hours of trial and error and we are blessed to have a gathering of VR and RPG enthusiasts accompany us each step along the way. We cannot express enough of how much we appreciate you, the Grimlord community, and all the inspiration and encouragement you have brought us. We wouldn’t dare to dream big and make it a reality without your support. Achieving Early Access is something to remember, your love and support, is something we hold dear.

A special thanks to our amazing voice actors, you brought our characters to life, this game wouldn’t be the same without your outstanding performance!
The Blacksmith – @Stephen Carlock
The Herbalist – @Clark Casey
Rheala – @Elizabeth Nightingale
The Faithless -- @Jonathan Cox

The legend of his brutality traversed the land, he lured innocent children into his domain in a trail of treats, sealed their scared little faces in with pumpkin heads. 
Once the children came of age, the pumpkins pop open, and the number of his faithful followers grow, with tormented souls.
Now, he wants you to see the world through his eyes, through the narrow gaze of the Pumpkin head. 
It’s time to rid him of this world.

Even though he enjoys trickery, he doesn’t let any filthy peasants come near him. He will teleport away from you in the blink of an eye and continue his attacks.

      We got tons of feedback in the past few weeks following the release of Grimlord’s demo, we were thrilled to get to know your experience with the game. And, we brought some new content for this amazing game fest, just update the game and give it a try.
      In this new patch, we added hit effects of magic spells into the game, enemies will be frozen (added in the last update), paralyzed and burnt after being hit. These effects will restrict enemies’ movement in each of their unique ways and beef up the AOE abilities of sorcerer class.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/0586e10930ae4d3c6816d1845f10e112f361ba1b.gif[/img]
now we just can't afford igoring staffs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/e698be7031f442be6098bc9191bccd439f28bc6b.gif[/img]
Other than that, we removed potion slots from the game, instead, there is a small satchel to carry your consumables. We hope to mimic the realistic experience of finding items in your bags, when putting your hand on the satchel, you will see an UI prompt, press the trigger button to cycle through your items, then you can pull out the one you wanted. When putting your item back into the satchel, simple move it to wherever you want to put in inside the satchel then release the grab button (if using the Check on mode, then you need only to press the grab button once to put your item back).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/353acafa6feafcac956c796d7720730467c68811.gif[/img]
      Since we added a satchel in the game, there will be more items coming up soon, and, to let you guys get a hands-on feeling of how new items can alter the way you play the game, we added black powder grenades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/0a38454f28a7aa2701b182a32094aa4e036f76ad.gif[/img]
You can throw them toward those filthy enemies and watch them explode into bits and pieces. Black powder grenades can be found in certain areas and enemies have a small chance of dropping them.
After this update, we will concentrate on the game’s beta version, if you are interested in our game, please add our game to your wish list or join our discord to talk about all things Grimlord, you may even get a passcode for beta test. We have high hopes for Grimlord and there will be more content coming up soon. 
      We appreciate each and every one of your comment and suggestion.
Thank you for playing our game, thank you for your support!

[b]List of changes:[/b]

[b]New features:[/b]
1.A satchel to hold consumables and small items.
2.Black powder grenade, cause small explosion and AOE burn damage.
3.Items found in the level will not be disposed by teleportation.
4.Added turn page option in storage (weapons and inventory).
5.Enemies will have a small chance of dropping black powder grenades.
6.Paralyze effect by lightning magic.
7.Burn effect by fire magic.
8.Frozen effect by ice magic.

[b]List of fixes:[/b]
9.Fixed incorrect damage effect when disabled gore.
10. Fixed weird weapon slips.
11.Fixed virtual desktop link controller angle and button configuration problems.

Dear fellow adventurers:
We got tons of feedback during one week of our game’s demo release, we read through all of them and appreciate each and every one, we are improving many aspects of the game based on your suggestions and experience with Grimlord, particularly the one with Index controller adaptation, so we made some tweaks and changes in this update.

notes.title: Grimlord Demo v0.1.7 Release
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

We are excited to announce that the demo build is now alive for players to download. The demo demonstrates a early-stage version where elements could be improved or replaced. Please receive this demo version as an appetizer and an invitation to our beta tests in the future. By disclosing the developing progressions, we would love to know your feedbacks and suggestions

The goal is to make Grimlord fits the community’s preferences. We are looking forward to know our feedback. We appreciate your attention and your patience more than you ever know. We hope you enjoy the demo!

[url=https://discord.gg/e5Tv8PMEPx]Join our discord[/url] 
 - meet our amazing members
 - talk to devs in person
 - win free beta keys

[h3]List of Improvements[/h3]
1.Improved the effects of numerous physical collisions.
2.Adjusted the index gripping configuration, making weapons easier to hold.
3.Altered the descriptions on a number of weapons.
4.Added a swapping movement when casting spells with a staff.
5.Improved enemies’ getting up animation making them no longer stuck player’s weapon.
6.Improved bosses’ hit reaction animation, making them easier to stun.
7.Improved lighting
8.Improved blood splatter
9.Added game logo at the start menu.

[h3]EA version[/h3]
A huge and complex world map that’s 3-4 times the demo size for players to explore, and that’s merely the first chapter of the game.
A whole type of humanoid creatures’ combat logic and AI will be tested in game.
The initial talent system is being completed.
At least two other boss fights.
Adding a number of NPCs to give assignments and forge weapons and armors for you.
New eye-drawing clothes and armor.
A climbing system.
Adding more treasure chest in different sections in the game.
Adding more move sets and special attacks 
Weapon handling and enemy reaction will be adjusted further.
Adding more weapon skills and abilities.

[h3]Contents updates further down the road[/h3]
5 chapters approximately.
Memorable boss fights in each chapter.
A Firekeeper type NPC guaranteed.
Legendary weapons (Might be in the temple that descent into darkness, all you need to do is find it and pull it out)
Extensive character creation
Female player body
Weapon trading 
Some replayable dungeons
Co-op mode (planned)
PVP mode (planned)
